blocks.content: We will use a heap to implement a priority queue.
There are four main operations we will be performing in a min-priority queue:

items: Insert: To insert a new element into the queue.
Peek: To peek the minimum element from the queue.
Extract Min: To remove and return the minimum element from the queue.
Increase / Decrease Key: To increase or decrease the key (priority) of any element in the queue.
